objective: When a user taps an Android keyboard GIF while writing a Public Wall comment, return the GIF directly to that same comment preview with Send available, removing the interrupting external-share alert.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main source 9ff4f65d0db52b584d915493f67edaaed8bae369 read at branch creation. Current device/native GIF dispatch, production OTA artifact and served release were not verified; this remains isolated DEV only.
chosenApproach: Retain the latest comment post ID for up to five minutes in account-scoped AsyncStorage, then when expo-sharing receives an ACTION_SEND GIF, stage it and reopen the authorized post's existing comment drawer with a GIF preview and its manual Send action. Preserve the original comment RPC, media upload and reaction flows, and use a dismissible inline fallback when no target remains.
selectionRationale: An incremental JS-only recovery path fixes the observed Gboard share-to-Wall dialog without requiring a new native IME bridge, changing Expo runtime, rewriting the composer, weakening post permissions, or publishing a GIF as a standalone Wall post.
alternativeApproaches: Intercept Android IME commitContent using a custom native TextInput module: deferred, because it changes native binary compatibility and requires rebuilding and verifying the APK.
Auto-publish the GIF immediately on ACTION_SEND: rejected, because it can attach to the wrong post and bypass user review.
preserveBehaviors: Existing Community Wall comment text, replies, mentions, private photo/GIF paths, 25MB limits and manual Send semantics remain unchanged.
Current Wall feed, ads, video audio lifecycle, Marites, offline/weak-signal states and bottom tab navigation remain intact.
Account isolation and authorization-enforced post detail lookup; no cross-account restore or guessed destination.
No changes to Supabase RLS, backend RPC, production OTA channel, Android native runtime or Play Store artifact.
acceptanceChecks: Android keyboard GIF selected from an active comment returns to that same comment drawer with animated preview, and Send remains user-controlled.
No blocking GIF ready for comment or GIF attached alerts in the active comment path.
If Android recreates the Wall Activity, restore target post using existing detail RPC and account-bound short-lived ID.
Wrong account, expired target or inaccessible post never causes cross-post auto-send; fallback requires explicit post selection.
Existing text/photo posting, media upload, GIF gallery picker, comment RPC, video rendering and ads remain unaffected.
Engineering Accountability and Performance CI gates pass; exact Android/Web compiled RC and device behavior require separate verification before production publication.

preservedBehaviors: Original upload/comment RPC, user-generated text, feeds, ads, video players and user permissions are not modified.
